name: parentlock-ui
description: ParentLock — experiência mobile-first para proteção familiar com consentimento.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:admin && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:admin: npm run build:admin && npx cap sync android && (cd android && ./gradlew assembleAdminDebug --no-daemon --stacktrace)
scripts.apk:companion: npm run build:companion && npx cap sync android && (cd android && ./gradlew assembleCompanionDebug --no-daemon --stacktrace)
scripts.apk:both: npm run build:admin && npx cap sync android && (cd android && ./gradlew assembleAdminDebug --no-daemon --stacktrace) && npm run build:companion && npx cap sync android && (cd android && ./gradlew assembleCompanionDebug --no-daemon --stacktrace)
